name: Never Giving Up
overview: Scripture encourages believers to persevere with courage and hope, grounded in the assurance of God's presence and strength. God commands us to be strong and unafraid because He is with us wherever we go, promising to uphold and help us in times of trouble. Our hope in the Lord strengthens our hearts, enabling us to remain patient in trials and persistent in prayer. Jesus invites all who are weary to come to Him for rest, reminding us that enduring faith is sustained by continual hope and praise.
